description: Add or move a document under the project's documentation directory (e.g. docs/). Use whenever someone wants to create a new spec, decision record, overview, business/pricing note, design doc, blog draft, or archive an old one — or move/rename an existing doc. The documentation tree is organized by purpose with a strict authority hierarchy and a single source of truth for pricing and business rules; this skill enforces the four rules so a new file does not reintroduce the confusion the structure was built to remove.
